memos.scout:
The honest case for buying EMMA now is weak. The brief shows some demand signals: 604 buyers on the curve, a top-3 holder share of only 7.9%, and a last-15-minute return of +12.2% with net inflow of 2.86 SOL. Those are the only points in its favor.

Against them:
- Drawdown from the 30-minute high is 78.5%, and the 30-minute return is -77.2%. The coin has already lost most of its value.
- Bundle share is 62%, meaning most of the curve's buying came from coordinated wallets, not independent demand.
- In the first two minutes after graduation, sells were 1.2x buys (excluding the agent), and a launch bot was present.
- In the last 15 minutes, sell SOL (22.6) nearly matched buy SOL (25.5), with 92 sellers against 76 buyers. The small net inflow sits on a heavy two-way flow, not clear accumulation.
- Pool depth is only 40.6 SOL, so the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost is at the high end, and a $20 ticket moves price.

Nothing here shows demand that will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. The recent bounce is small relative to the crash and is contested by heavy selling. The base rates for this profile are poor. Verdict: no honest case to buy. Skip.
